Subject: Pre-call: forecast submission window — ownership matrix & 15m agenda

Team — quick heads up for today's numbers window: final forecast submission locks at 15:00 PT. We have a 15-minute pre-call at 10:30 PT to align owners and surface anything blocking final commit. Please do the following before the call:

- Update stage and commit decision in HubSpot for any live deal you own (deal notes + stage reasons).
- For deals > $250k, add one-line risk summary and mitigation in the deal notes.
- Ensure the "ownership_matrix_q3_v2.xlsx" has your primary/backup owner filled.

Agenda (10:30 PT — remote, -> call link in calendar):
1) Quick roll call & ownership confirmation (5m)
2) Top 8 live deals review (7m) — owner, stage change, risk flag
3) Confirm final submission ETA and blockers (3m)

Attachments: ownership_matrix_q3_v2.xlsx (xlsx), precall_checklist.md (md)

If you cannot make the 10:30 slot, reply with who will cover and call out any deals you believe should be pulled into "no-commit". I will circulate a short notes doc after the call.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior RevOps Analyst | Redwood Inference
